prompts.satzmeister:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create ONE square transparent game boss portrait for Monster Slam, matching a coordinated two-portrait set.
Reference roles: pitch_boss_0400.png is the exact character identity reference (ignore its interface, lettering and scene); play.webp and skills.webp are painted menu-icon style references; rambler_01_front_idle.png is only context for the companion character, do not include that character.
Subject: Der Satzmeister, the small friendly-cheeky skeleton magician from the gameplay screenshot. Preserve the huge broad-brim magenta pointed hat, its angular silhouette and darker purple underside, ivory skull with a wide grin of chunky teeth and small warm yellow eyes deep in dark sockets, burgundy/wine-red robe with three pale blue-silver buttons, white gloves, and a plain blue book held at the lower chest. No added emblems.
Composition: centered waist-up/bust, very slightly three-quarter front view, whole hat and both shoulders contained, face large and clearly readable at 96–128 px display height; square canvas with approximately 3% transparent padding around the complete silhouette. Torso ends naturally at bottom. Character alone, no frame, no lettering.
Style: polished hand-painted fantasy game inventory/menu icon like the golden play icon and stone book icon references, rich saturated colors, subtly faceted planes compatible with the original low-poly model, broad simple readable forms, soft luminous edge highlights. Friendly mischievous expression. Not photorealistic.
Lighting: warm soft key from upper left, gentle cool blue-violet fill on the lower right; clear bright silhouette on a dark navy card.
Background: actual transparent alpha, no scenery, no floor, no drop shadow, no colored backdrop, no checkerboard pattern. No text, letters, numbers, watermark, border, or UI.
prompts.rambler:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create ONE square transparent game boss portrait: The Rambler from Monster Slam, the companion portrait to the provided skeleton-magician portrait.
Reference roles: rambler_01_front_idle.png is the exact character identity and anatomy reference; the newly painted skeleton-magician portrait is the matching style, lighting, scale and bust-framing reference; play.webp and skills.webp are the original painted menu-icon style references.
Subject: a friendly talkative puffed-up bookworm paper dragon. Faithfully translate the model: its HEAD IS A HORIZONTAL GREEN BOOK, its green covers form upper and lower jaws, cream page block between them, small triangular paper teeth and a long plain red bookmark tongue hanging out centrally. Above the book head are TWO HUGE ROUND BRASS READING GLASSES with bulging cream-white eyes and large dark round pupils, with short dark green rectangular brows above them. Two short rolled-paper antennae/horns with tan rolled ends rise behind the glasses. At either side of the head/shoulders are wings made of fan-shaped cream and warm tan paper sheets, WITHOUT writing. Below the head, a short green collar and inflated round torso made of layered cream paper rings bounded by dark green book-cover edges. Match the actual colors and shape from the gameplay model, do not turn it into a reptilian flesh dragon.
Composition: centered frontal waist-up bust, same square canvas, same head visual scale and torso endpoint as skeleton portrait; show entire horns, glasses and paper fans, keep approximately 3% transparent margin around silhouette. Eyes engaging the viewer, good-natured chatty open mouth. Strong legible silhouette at 96–128 px.
Style: exactly match the provided painted skeleton portrait and existing menu icons: rich saturated colors, painterly fantasy game icon, softly highlighted edges and subtly faceted low-poly planes, broad readable details. Warm upper-left key light and cool blue-violet lower-right fill, cream paper and forest-green covers, restrained brass frames and red tongue.
Background: actual transparent alpha. Character alone. No floor, scene, drop shadow, colored backdrop, checkerboard, frame, UI, symbols, text, letters, numbers, or watermark. Blank paper surfaces throughout.
